text: Jack Torrance [takes the winter caretaker job|trigger|saying yes to an offer] at the Overlook Hotel, high in the Colorado Rockies, though a previous caretaker killed his family there. His son Danny, who shares a telepathic gift with the chef Hallorann, sees the murdered Grady sisters and is warned away from Room 237. As snow seals them in, Jack drinks with [ghostly figures in the ballroom|images|ghosts and strange figures], types one proverb over and over, and [takes up an axe against his wife and son|wrong|cruelty at home].
